acceptance_criteria: Exact 60/20 worlds, 142184/45942 sequences, 39310/13693 identity-valid observations, 102874/32249 open-set observations, 3380/1113 disjoint identities and all ten topology families are preserved.

Pair cache independently rebuilds 57066/18111 open-set and 135232/45372 total fit/selection pairs; sparse global identities retain minimum 0, maximum 208227, nine legal gaps and 20102 omitted C09 identities.

All three seeds use their exact sealed GSE checkpoints with zero backbone optimizer step. Inputs exclude pose, identity, parent, traversal and future information and include all six frozen exit descriptors/headings/widths/vertical profiles.
Exit-token pair features are exactly left/right symmetric, independently token-permutation invariant and independently global-yaw invariant; trainable parameter count is exactly 112898.

Each seed independently has a nonempty selected threshold with aggregate precision>=0.98, false merge<=0.01 and recall>=0.25; every topology family has nonempty acceptance, precision>=0.95 and recall>=0.10.
C09/C10/M-TARE reads remain zero; source seals remain identical before/after; host RSS<=8GiB, GPU allocation<=4GiB, duration<=6h and output<=2GiB.
baseline: Sealed V1R lightweight aggregate verifier: at approximately 25% recall, seed precision=0.975862/0.981040/0.980123 with 2.4138%/1.8960%/1.9877% false merges; post-hoc three-seed mean remains unsafe at 1.2041% and is not adopted.

corrective_contract.correction: full frozen per-exit descriptor/heading/width/vertical token-set features with exact symmetry, token-permutation invariance and independent global-yaw invariance; fit-only hard-negative tail-risk loss
corrective_contract.predecessor_gap: V1R retained only five exit-query aggregates and omitted trained per-exit descriptors; all three seeds exceeded 1% false merges at substantive recall

estimated_cost.compute: One RTX 5090 D, three serial frozen GSE inference passes and three 112898-parameter token-aware verifier trainings; <=8GiB host RSS, <=4GiB PyTorch allocation, zero simulator/ROS.

expected_evidence: Approved Data Card/spec, rebuilt pair manifest/cache hashes, predecessor and source seals, frozen environment.
Three frozen observation arrays and full typed exit-token archives, fit-only normalization, epoch logs, best checkpoints and complete C07-C08 score archives.
Aggregate and all-ten-family precision/recall/accepted counts per seed, resource metrics, raw logs, RUN_STATE and complete SHA-256 seal.
method: For each frozen GSE seed, export deployment-only observation features and all six exit tokens over C01-C08. Fit a 112898-parameter matchability plus symmetric verifier on C01-C06. Its 473D pair input combines the V1 base features with 180 features from mutual-nearest trained exit descriptors, matched width/profile/confidence, yaw-invariant heading Gram signatures and sorted token distributions. Association loss targets the lowest positives and an equal count of highest-scoring negatives. Select checkpoint and one non-vacuous threshold on C07-C08 only.

optimization.checkpoint_selection: minimum complete C07-C08 class-balanced association BCE independently per seed
optimization.model: Matchability 146->64->1 and pair 473->192->64->1, 112898 trainable parameters; frozen GSE backbone
optimization.tail_risk_loss: equal weight to lowest-scoring positives and the same count of highest-scoring negatives in each fit batch
optimization.threshold_selection: maximum recall subject to aggregate precision>=0.98, false accept<=0.01, recall>=0.25 and per-family nonempty precision>=0.95/recall>=0.10

pair_contract.candidate_definition: same parent, association-valid candidate, strictly lower world_sequence_row, 3D Euclidean sensor-position distance <=16m, nearest distance then lower global sequence index

question: Can the frozen GSE per-exit descriptors and geometry, used through a rotation/permutation-invariant token set matcher with hard-negative tail-risk training, reduce false merges to <=1% while retaining >=25% recall and per-family nonempty safety?
stop_conditions: Any V1/V1R cache, frozen feature, normalization or checkpoint artifact is reused, or any pair/sparse-identity count drifts.
Any pose/identity/world/traversal/future field enters the model; any token symmetry/permutation/yaw invariant fails.
Any source, checkpoint, tool, environment, split, feature, resource or evidence drift; any C09/C10/M-TARE read or backbone update.
Any seed lacks the original non-vacuous passing threshold. Seal FAIL and stop before C09 topology; do not ensemble, lower gates or tune graph/planner parameters.

user_authorization.confirmation_reference: The user selected option A, granted continuous autonomous in-scope execution, and instructed choosing the optimal path without repeated approvals.
user_authorization.scope: One immutable V2 within user-selected option A, using exact V1R data/pairs/frozen checkpoints and unchanged gates; add only full exit-token set matching and fit-only hard-negative tail-risk loss; no V1R partial reuse and zero C09/C10/M-TARE reads.
